description: This Kotlin source file defines an internal object `DeviceAuthPayload` that provides functions to build an authorization payload string (`buildV3`) and normalize metadata fields (`normalizeMetadataField`) for device authentication purposes.

methods.name: buildV3
methods.description: Constructs an authorization payload string based on device ID, client info, roles, scopes, timestamp, token, nonce, platform, and device family.

methods.name: normalizeMetadataField
methods.description: Normalizes a metadata string by trimming whitespace and converting uppercase ASCII letters to lowercase for cross-runtime consistency.
